name: Tomato Early Blight
symptoms: dark concentric spots on leaves;yellowing around spots;leaf drop;stem lesions
treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil fungicide every 7-10 days; remove infected leaves; ensure crop rotation.

name: Tomato Late Blight
symptoms: water-soaked spots on leaves;white fungal growth under leaves;rapid leaf collapse;brown lesions on stem
treatment: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb combination fungicide immediately; destroy infected plants; avoid overhead irrigation.

name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus
symptoms: upward curling of leaves;yellowing of leaf margins;stunted growth;reduced fruit size
treatment: Control whitefly vector using Imidacloprid; remove infected plants; use virus-resistant varieties.

name: Tomato Bacterial Wilt
symptoms: sudden wilting of plant;yellowing of lower leaves;brown discoloration inside stem;plant collapse without yellowing
treatment: Use resistant varieties; remove and destroy infected plants; avoid waterlogging; practice crop rotation.

name: Tomato Fruit Borer
symptoms: holes in fruit;larvae inside fruit;fruit rot;frass near entry holes
treatment: Use pheromone traps; spray neem-based insecticide; remove and destroy infested fruits.

name: Potato Late Blight
symptoms: water-soaked spots on leaves;white fungal growth under leaves;blackened stem;tuber rot
treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Metalaxyl fungicide; destroy infected foliage; avoid excess field moisture.

name: Potato Common Scab
symptoms: rough corky patches on tubers;raised lesions on tuber skin;reduced tuber quality
treatment: Maintain soil pH below 5.5; avoid excess lime application; use certified disease-free seed tubers.

name: Wheat Leaf Rust
symptoms: orange-brown pustules on leaves;yellowing of leaf tissue;premature leaf drying
treatment: Spray Propiconazole fungicide; use rust-resistant wheat varieties; avoid late sowing.

name: Wheat Powdery Mildew
symptoms: white powdery coating on leaves;stunted growth;yellowing of lower leaves
treatment: Apply sulfur-based fungicide; ensure proper plant spacing for airflow; avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer.

name: Wheat Loose Smut
symptoms: black powdery spore mass replacing grain head;empty seed head;early ear emergence
treatment: Treat seeds with Carboxin or Vitavax before sowing; use certified disease-free seed.

name: Rice Blast
symptoms: diamond-shaped lesions on leaves;grayish center with brown margin on spots;neck rot;empty grain panicles
treatment: Apply Tricyclazole fungicide; avoid excess nitrogen; use resistant rice varieties.

name: Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight
symptoms: water-soaked streaks on leaf edges;yellowing and drying of leaves;wilting of seedlings
treatment: Use Streptocycline spray; avoid water stagnation; use certified disease-free seeds.

name: Rice Brown Planthopper
symptoms: yellowing and drying of plants in patches;stunted growth;hopper burn appearance;honeydew on leaves
treatment: Spray Imidacloprid or Buprofezin; avoid excess nitrogen; drain standing water periodically.

name: Rice Tungro Virus
symptoms: yellow-orange discoloration of leaves;stunted plant growth;reduced tillering
treatment: Control leafhopper vector with Imidacloprid; remove infected plants; use resistant varieties.

name: Maize Turcicum Leaf Blight
symptoms: long elliptical gray-green lesions on leaves;lesions turning tan with age;leaf blighting
treatment: Apply Mancozeb or Propiconazole fungicide; practice crop rotation; use resistant hybrids.

name: Maize Stem Borer
symptoms: holes in stem;dead heart in young plants;frass visible at leaf whorl
treatment: Apply Chlorantraniliprole or Carbofuran granules in whorl; remove and destroy affected plants.

name: Cotton Bacterial Blight
symptoms: angular water-soaked spots on leaves;black lesions on veins;boll rot;leaf shedding
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride; use disease-free treated seeds; avoid overhead irrigation during humid periods.

name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus
symptoms: upward curling of leaves;thickened leaf veins;stunted plant growth;reduced boll formation
treatment: Control whitefly population using Imidacloprid or neem-based spray; remove and destroy infected plants.

name: Cotton Bollworm
symptoms: holes in cotton bolls;larvae feeding inside bolls;boll shedding
treatment: Use pheromone traps; spray Spinosad or Bt-based insecticide; hand-pick and destroy infested bolls.

name: Sugarcane Red Rot
symptoms: reddish discoloration inside stalk;drying of leaves;foul smell from stalk;white patches inside stem
treatment: Use disease-free setts for planting; treat setts with fungicide before planting; practice crop rotation.

name: Sugarcane Smut
symptoms: black whip-like structure from growing point;stunted cane growth;thin tillers
treatment: Use disease-free setts; rogue out infected clumps early; grow resistant varieties.

name: Chilli Anthracnose
symptoms: sunken dark spots on fruit;concentric rings on lesions;fruit rot;premature fruit drop
treatment: Spray Carbendazim or Mancozeb fungicide; avoid overhead irrigation; harvest at proper maturity.

name: Chilli Leaf Curl Virus
symptoms: upward and downward leaf curling;leaf thickening;stunted plant growth
treatment: Control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid; remove infected plants; use resistant varieties.

name: Groundnut Tikka Leaf Spot
symptoms: circular brown spots on leaves;yellow halo around spots;premature leaf fall
treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb fungicide; practice crop rotation; avoid dense planting.

name: Groundnut Bud Necrosis Virus
symptoms: necrotic ring spots on leaves;bud necrosis;stunted plant growth
treatment: Control thrips vector using Imidacloprid; remove infected plants; use resistant varieties.

name: Soybean Rust
symptoms: small reddish-brown pustules on leaves;yellowing of leaves;premature defoliation
treatment: Apply Tebuconazole or Propiconazole fungicide; use resistant varieties; avoid dense canopy.

name: Onion Purple Blotch
symptoms: purple-brown lesions on leaves;concentric rings on lesions;leaf tip dieback
treatment: Spray Mancozeb fungicide; avoid overhead irrigation; ensure proper field drainage.

name: Banana Panama Wilt
symptoms: yellowing of older leaves;splitting of pseudostem;wilting of leaves;internal stem discoloration
treatment: Use disease-free planting material; improve field drainage; avoid planting in infected soil.

name: Banana Bunchy Top Virus
symptoms: bunched and stunted leaves at top;dark green streaks on veins;narrow upright leaves
treatment: Control aphid vector; remove and destroy infected plants; use virus-free planting material.

name: Mustard Aphid Infestation
symptoms: curling of leaves;sticky honeydew on leaves;sooty mold growth;stunted plant growth
treatment: Spray Imidacloprid or neem oil; encourage natural predators; remove heavily infested shoots early.
